|game_text=Deploy on [[Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Yavin 4]]. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)]]. Other errata versions: [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-00-Restore_Freedom_To_The_Galaxy-PC-E2-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026; icons drawn as on the slip; CardMaker does not draw the [Setup] icon on the Critical Mission banner). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-restorefreedomtothegalaxy-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E1 text (see [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)]]): first printing of the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on Yavin 4 system. Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck face up there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 8, slip 46 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> That first printing is not preserved; the text is the re-made sheet's text with “Yavin 4 system”, which the Players Committee news post of 28 June 2010 corrected to “Yavin 4”.<ref name="src-S3">Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications", 28 June 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" (28 June 2010) changed “Deploy on Yavin 4 system” to “Deploy on Yavin 4”: “Deploy on Yavin 4. Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck face up there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.”<ref name="src-S3" /> The re-made Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (copy re-made 28 July 2010) prints this text.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1" />
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) removed “face up” (“stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck there”): “Deploy on Yavin 4. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.”<ref name="cl-1271_46-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list writes the slip's icons out (▼ as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, ▲ as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”); that alone is not a version.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “from either player's Reserve Deck” to “from any Reserve Deck”, restored “face up” and changed “to 'liberate' the system.” to “, and, while stacked there, system is 'liberated.'”: “Deploy on Yavin 4. Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from any Reserve Deck face up there (limit one per system), and, while stacked there, system is 'liberated.' At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=47, page 47. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=47 Internet Archive]</ref>
